Title: Gallstones Are the #1 Cause of Pancreatitis in the US

Description:
Sharp pain under your right ribs after a fatty meal, plus eyes turning a little yellow? That points to your gallbladder, not just your stomach - and in the US, gallstones cause 35-40% of acute pancreatitis cases, more than any other cause.

Your gallbladder and pancreas share one drainage opening into the small intestine. When a stone blocks it, digestive enzymes back up into the pancreas instead of flowing out. Crash dieting and a low-fiber diet both raise your risk. Watch to find out why, and the simple diet swaps that lower it.

Pain under your right ribs after a fatty meal, and your eyes look a little yellow? 👀

In the US, gallstones - not alcohol - are the #1 cause of acute pancreatitis (35-40% of cases). A stone can block the shared duct between your gallbladder and pancreas, and digestive enzymes back up instead of flowing out.

Crash diets and low-fiber eating both raise your risk. Losing weight slowly and adding more beans, oats, and veggies helps.
